title: Extremely Lifelike Fishing
intro: Sit in a pedal-drive kayak and fish with your own arm: the shoulder and the elbow each have their own keys, so casting takes practice. Or take the speedboat out and run the water fast.
no_webgl: This game draws with WebGL, and this browser does not offer the version it needs. A recent Chrome, Firefox or Safari does.
how.cast: Cast: hold F, swing the rod back with W, swing it forward with S, and let go of F as the rod passes upright. A and D bend and straighten the elbow.
how.sink: Watch Lure depth on the left. With the bail open the lure sinks and line runs out; press Space at the depth your fish swims to close the bail.
how.work: Wind in bursts with Space, then pause. Hold E for the power wind: it pulls line in short bursts at {power} m/s and runs on a battery that lasts {battery} s and refills in {recharge} s.
how.set: On a bite you have about {hold} s: wind with Space and sweep the rod up hard with W together, which takes up any slack first. In the scope the mouth zone ring turns green while the hook is inside it.
how.fight: Fish on: the cue under the message says Wind or Hold. Wind with Space on Wind; stop on Hold and let the drag give line. A tired fish comes in and is landed once it is close.
how.scope: Hold the right mouse button for the scope: it looks at the mouth of the fish nearest the lure, through the kayak if it must, and the wheel zooms up to {zoom}×.
ring.label: Tension
arms.heading: Casting arm
hint.cast: Hold F, swing the rod back with W, then forward with S, and let go of F.
hint.running: Line is running out; the lure is {depth} m down. Press Space to close the bail.
hint.work: Lure {depth} m down, moving {speed} m/s. Wind in bursts and pause, or hold E to power-wind.
hint.following: A {fish} is following. Pause now: most bites come as the lure stops.
hint.fight: Fish on. Wind on the Wind cue; stop on the Hold cue and let the drag work.
event.bit: Bite. Set the hook: wind with Space and sweep the rod up hard with W.
event.hook_set: Hooked a {fish}. Keep the line tight.
event.threw: The line went slack and the hook came loose.
event.jumped: It jumped. Keep the line tight.
event.snapped: The line snapped. A new lure is tied on.
landed.heading: Landed
settings.heading: Settings
settings.note: Slower arms make casting easier. They never change how a fish behaves.
how.species: {fish}: swims {from} to {to} m down and follows a lure moving {slow} to {fast} m/s through the water.
how.follow: A fish that follows often bites as the lure stops, so pause when the message says one is following.
hint.set: It has the lure. Set the hook now: wind with Space and sweep the rod up hard with W.
hint.land: The {fish} is tiring. Wind it in close, or hold E to haul it in.
how.haul: When the cue says Haul, the fish is tired and close: hold E and the power wind hauls it out of the water and into your hands.
how.river: The current runs round the loop without end. Trout hold in the eddy behind each rock, facing upstream: cast above a rock and let the current bring the lure past it.
how.throttle: Up and Down: throttle forward and back. The speedboat lifts and planes as it gathers speed.
how.steer: Left and Right: steer. Turn hard at speed and the hull slides before it bites.
how.jump: Meet a swell at speed and the hull leaves the water; it lands where the waves are when it comes down.
hint.drive: Up to open the throttle, Left and Right to steer. Esc for the menu.
